summary: Candy Crush Saga entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Candy Crush Saga

emulation.emulator: None for primary; device capture preferred
emulation.notes: Use Android emulation only if account, timing, ads, and event behavior match the real device build being documented.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Modern mobile device at native app resolution

primary.why: Candy Crush Saga began as a Facebook/browser title and expanded to iOS, Android, Windows Phone, Windows, and other storefronts. The current mobile app route is the strongest practical route for a live puzzle service with account sync and current level/event support.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current App Store or Google Play build, sign into the same account if preserving progress matters, and record app version/date because level counts and events change.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a live puzzle service, not a fixed campaign. Dreamworld and historical event states should be treated as archival research topics, not assumed current content.
